verdict.rationale: PostHog is open-source/self-hostable (MIT Docker Compose) and offers SQL/API/data-warehouse querying plus an OpenAPI spec, which supports data portability and self-managed exit paths. However, there is no explicit documentation of a bulk 'export all my data' feature or open-format data export/dump for account closure scenarios. missing for 10: dedicated full-account data export tool/format, documentation of GDPR-style data portability or account deletion with export, independent confirmation of successful full export in practice.
